question: 一共有多少个客户？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: 销量最高的 3 个商品是什么？（只算已完成订单）
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

question: 哪个城市的客户最多？
reference_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 库存最少的商品是哪个？
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 1

question: 2026 年 8 月已完成订单的销售额是多少元？
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-08%'

question: 每个月的销售额分别是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7)

question: 已取消的订单有多少个？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = '已取消'

question: 已完成订单的平均客单价（每单平均金额）是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成'

question: 哪个类目的销售额最高？
reference_sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 平均评分最低的商品是哪个？
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) ASC LIMIT 1

question: 已完成订单数最多的客户是谁？
reference_sql: SELECT cu.name FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY cu.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026 年第一季度有多少个已完成订单？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

question: 价格最贵的商品是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: 《三体》全集一共卖出了多少套？（只算已完成订单）
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND p.name LIKE '%三体%'

question: 库存低于 50 的商品有几个？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock < 50

question: 退款的订单有多少个？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = '已退款'

question: 上海有多少个客户？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = '上海'

question: 5 星评价有多少条？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5

question: 图书类目下有几个商品？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = '图书'

question: 哪个月的销售额最高？
reference_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1
